title: questlog registry.json
description: USER-LEVEL roadmap registry that lets the central dashboard discover every roadmap on this machine. Lives at ~/.questlog/registry.json by default, overridable with the QUESTLOG_REGISTRY environment variable. This is a single user-global file, NOT part of any project's .questlog/ directory, so validate.mjs (which validates one project dir) does not check it. Reads are tolerant everywhere: a missing or corrupt file is treated as { schemaVersion: 1, roadmaps: [] }. Dead entries (a dir that no longer exists) are kept and reported missing, never removed automatically. An entry MAY carry an optional origin edge naming the parent roadmap + portal milestone it branched from (absent OR null = a root); origin is operator data (not jargon-linted, carries no plain field). Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.1.

id.description: REQUIRED. Stable registry id, prefix "rm-". Derived once from the directory basename slug (or random hex); NEVER regenerated for an existing dir.

name.description: REQUIRED non-empty display name. Refreshed on every upsert from the project's roadmap.json project.name, falling back to the directory basename.

dir.description: REQUIRED. Absolute, path.resolve()d project root — the folder that CONTAINS .questlog/, not the .questlog subdir itself.

addedAt.description: REQUIRED. Set once at first registration; never changed afterward.

lastSeenAt.description: REQUIRED. Bumped on every upsert (auto-register at dir-mode startup, a roadmap_register call, or a roadmap_set_origin call).

origin.description: OPTIONAL. Absent OR null = a ROOT roadmap. Present = the family-tree edge to the PARENT this road branched from (promotion births a child, never an orphan; the edge is permanent data). Registry-only, operator text — never jargon-linted, no plain field. Set/changed by roadmap_register (both-or-neither origin args) or roadmap_set_origin. Cycles and self-edges are rejected at write time; a parent id not in the registry is a tolerated orphan (greyed edge, never a crash).

roadmapId.description: REQUIRED. Registry id of the parent roadmap (prefix "rm-"). Must NOT equal this entry's own id (self-edge) and must not close a cycle up the parent chain.

milestoneId.description: REQUIRED. Id of the portal milestone IN THE PARENT road (any quest — a promoted side quest's milestones live on that side quest). Milestone existence in the parent is NOT enforced at write time; the serve-time overlay degrades gracefully (milestoneMissing) if it was renamed or deleted.

ts.description: REQUIRED. When the edge was recorded. Always set by the server (never caller-supplied).

sessionId.description: OPTIONAL. AI session that recorded the edge (free-form, <=200 chars, no control chars). Omitted when none resolves.
